Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a personalized gift product available for purchase in the store, with detailed information for display and ordering.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

name.description: The name of the product, as displayed to customers.

description.description: A comprehensive description of the product, including its features, customization options, and usage details.

price.description: The current selling price of the product.

categoryId.description: Reference to the Category this product belongs to, used for organization and filtering. (Relationship: Category 1:N Product)

mainImageUrl.description: The URL of the primary image displayed for the product in listings and quick views.

galleryImageUrls.description: An array of URLs for additional high-quality images showcasing the product from various angles or in different contexts.

isFeatured.description: A flag indicating whether this product should be highlighted as a featured item, typically on the homepage.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the product record was initially created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the product record was last modified.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a completed customer purchase, including customer details, ordered items, payment information, and timestamps.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

customerName.description: The full name of the customer who placed the order.

phone.description: The contact phone number provided by the customer for this order.

address.description: The complete shipping address provided by the customer.

city.description: The city component of the shipping address.

pincode.description: The postal code (pincode) component of the shipping address.

items.description: A list of individual products purchased within this order, including their details at the time of purchase.

total.description: The total monetary value of the order after including all items, taxes, and shipping.

paymentStatus.description: The current payment status of the order. Adhering strictly to the user's defined type, it can only be 'paid' for successfully processed orders.

razorpayOrderId.description: The unique order identifier assigned by Razorpay for the transaction.

razorpayPaymentId.description: The unique payment identifier assigned by Razorpay upon successful completion of the transaction.

razorpaySignature.description: The cryptographic signature provided by Razorpay for verifying the authenticity of the payment.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the order was initially placed by the customer.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Defines a classification category for products, enabling better organization, filtering, and navigation for customers.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

name.description: The user-friendly name of the product category (e.g., 'Light Lamps', 'Customized Gifts').

description.description: A brief explanation or summary of what products fall under this category.

slug.description: A URL-friendly string identifier for the category, used in routing and for SEO purposes (e.g., 'light-lamps').

imageUrl.description: An optional URL for an image or icon that visually represents the category.

PhotographyService.title: PhotographyService
PhotographyService.description: Showcases a specific photography service or portfolio item offered by PGK Studio, with details, images, and pricing information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PhotographyService entity.

title.description: The title or name of the photography service (e.g., 'Wedding Photography', 'Portrait Session').

description.description: A comprehensive description outlining what the service includes, its process, and key benefits.

type.description: The category or style of photography service (e.g., 'Wedding', 'Baby', 'Event', 'Product').

priceDescription.description: A human-readable string describing the pricing structure, such as 'Starting from ₹5000' or 'Custom Quote'.

mainImageUrl.description: The URL of the primary image or cover photo representing this photography service or portfolio.

galleryImageUrls.description: An array of URLs for additional images showcasing examples of work related to this photography service.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the photography service record was initially created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the photography service record was last modified.

ContactInfo.title: ContactInfo
ContactInfo.description: Stores the static contact details, physical address, social media links, and operational hours for PGK GIFTS & PGK STUDIO.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ContactInfo entity. Intended to represent a single, main contact information record (e.g., 'main').

addressStreet.description: The street address, building name, and other granular location details for the business.

addressCity.description: The city where the business is located.

addressPincode.description: The postal code associated with the business address.

addressDistrict.description: The district where the business is located.

addressState.description: The state where the business is located.

phonePrimary.description: The primary contact phone number for the business.

phoneAlternate1.description: An additional contact phone number for the business.

phoneAlternate2.description: A second additional contact phone number for the business.

email.description: The primary email address for customer inquiries and communication.

openingHoursMonFri.description: A descriptive string indicating the business's operating hours from Monday to Friday.

instagramUrl.description: The URL to the official Instagram profile of the business.

whatsappUrl.description: The direct WhatsApp chat link for customer support and inquiries.

youtubeUrl.description: The URL to the official YouTube channel of the business.

googleMapsUrl.description: The URL to the business's location on Google Maps for easy navigation.

latitude.description: The geographical latitude coordinate of the business location, used for embedding interactive maps.

longitude.description: The geographical longitude coordinate of the business location, used for embedding interactive maps.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the contact information was last updated.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for PGK GIFTS is designed with security, scalability, and debuggability as core priorities, strictly adhering to the mandated principles. This design prioritizes Authorization Independence through structural segregation and clear role-based access.

**Authorization Independence:**
1.  **Public Data (Products, Categories, Studio Services, Contact Info):** These collections (`/products`, `/categories`, `/studio_services`, `/settings/contactInfo`) are designed for public read access. Authorization is implicitly independent because no user-specific or sensitive data is mingled within. Any client can read these documents without needing to check related parent documents or complex permissions, thus eliminating `get()` calls in security rules for read operations.
2.  **Admin-Only Data (Orders, Admin Roles):** The `/orders` collection and the `/roles_admin` collection are secured for admin-only access for reads, and for writes to `/orders`, it's specifically a backend function. Authorization for admin access is achieved by checking the existence of a document in the `/roles_admin/{userId}` path. This denormalizes the admin role, allowing security rules to verify `request.auth.uid` against a top-level collection without any hierarchical `get()` operations. For instance, `allow read, write: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid));` is atomic and independent.

**Querying for Authorization Purposes (QAPs):**
1.  **Homogeneous Security Posture:** Each collection maintains a uniform security posture, which directly supports QAPs. For example:
    *   `/products`, `/categories`, `/studio_services`, `/settings/contactInfo`: All documents within these collections have the same 'public read' security requirement. This allows for simple, efficient `list` queries from any client without requiring complex rule filters that could inadvertently hide data or lead to inefficient scans. The rule `allow read: if true;` is sufficient for these collections.
    *   `/orders`: All documents here require 'admin read' access. An admin can list all orders, and the security rules ensure that `list` operations are only successful if the user is an admin, preventing unauthorized users from even initiating such queries. The rule `allow read: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid));` is effective for list operations.
    *   `/roles_admin`: This collection is solely for defining admin users. It allows efficient checks for admin status without filtering through other user data.

2.  **Path-Based Ownership (for Roles):** For the admin role, the path `/roles_admin/{userId}` directly ties the document to the authenticated user's ID. This makes ownership explicit and simple to verify in rules.

**Structural Segregation:**
*   Products and categories are in dedicated top-level collections, ensuring that their public accessibility rules are straightforward.
*   Orders, which have restricted access, reside in their own top-level collection, completely segregated from public-facing content. This prevents mixing security contexts and simplifies rule evaluation.
*   Studio services are separated into `/studio_services` to clearly distinguish them from physical products, even though they share similar public read access.

By following these principles, the Firestore structure ensures that security rules remain concise, easy to debug, and performant, avoiding the pitfalls of `get()` based authorization and enabling robust `list` operations.
